steps.content: [Cute Room]

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: "Tracy, I believe I was a little inconsiderate before. Could you spare some time to talk?" No, that... sounds too much like a manager calling someone in for a performance review...

Evie stands before the mirror of her dressing table, rehearsing over and over. One hand pinches the hem of her clothes, while the other clutches a little Mimi-meow hand puppet. Her expression is grave, as if she were preparing for a business negotiation.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: ...Okay let's see, how about... "I'm sorry, Tracy. I acted way out of line. I thought it over after I got home, and realized I never stopped to consider how much Phanuel means to you..."

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: "There's really no reason to be ashamed of fangirling just because of what other people think. I just... didn't want my parents to find out and think I was wasting away my life. But none of that's your fault. It's me who wasn't brave enough."

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: "Mimi-meow wouldn't want me to run myself into the ground for her, and I'm sure Phanuel wouldn't want you drowning in debt and losing your job over her either. If we can't even take care of ourselves, how would we support them? So, let's try to do better together, shall we?"
This time, when she finishes, she gives a small nod. Then, she carefully tucks the Mimi-meow puppet back into its secret hideout in the wardrobe.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Nailed it. Now I just need to go find Tracy first thing at work, apologize, and talk nicely... She'll definitely listen. Probably... maybe... surely, right?
[Black Screen Wipe Transition: Eastside Center]
By the time Evie arrives at the building, breathless and certain she's late, she finds the lobby completely jammed. The line snakes all the way from the turnstiles out to the plaza.

steps.speaker: Colleague A
steps.content: Is that the Public Security Bureau? What happened? Why won't they let us up? I've got a case I need to finish. Who's gonna take responsibility if my performance dips?

steps.speaker: Colleague B
steps.content: Apparently it's some official organization called the Bureau. Here to investigate that Hollow Syndrome thing. You know, the urban legend that's been blowing up online lately.

steps.speaker: Colleague A
steps.content: Wait, that thing's actually real? Sigh... if only they were here to shut down our stupid company for the ungodly overtime hours... Maybe then I'd actually get compensated.

Police tape stretches from the entrance to the office area, guarded by a handful of people in uniforms Evie's never seen before. She stands at the back of the crowd, clutching her bag, and every line she rehearsed at home instantly falls apart.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Um... did you say Hollow Syndrome...? Was it one of our coworkers?

steps.speaker: Colleague B
steps.content: Can't say for sure. I just got here as well. According to the overnight crew though, these people went straight to the contractors' area upstairs and kicked everyone out. Went after a specific workstation there, apparently.

steps.speaker: Colleague B
steps.content: You know, the one covered in... what was it again...? Oh right, Phanuel's merch.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: ...Tracy?!

steps.speaker: Colleague B
steps.content: You know her? Wait, yeah, I think her name was Tracy. People were just talking about her in the group chat, saying she'd gone off the deep end over some idol. Never would've thought that'd be enough to bring in some Bureau... hey, where are you going? Hey!

Right now, all Evie can think about is Tracy's eyes. Her coworkers' words don't register at all. She recalls how they grew redder and more hollow day by day, and thinks of the Cherub community she had buried herself in.
Did something... happen to Tracy?!
The moment Evie crosses the police tape, someone comes rushing out from nearby.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Hey! Who are you? We're in the middle of an investigation! You can't come in here!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: The one who got hurt might be my coworker... no, my friend! I'm sorry, I have to go in. I'm really sorry!
Evie forces her way in and charges to the workstation area in one breath.
[Black Screen Wipe Transition: Workstation]

That altar of a workstation in Evie's memory is now covered in evidence markers. Even she can tell—it's been transformed into a crime scene. The posters, photocards, folders, and merch boxes are all still there... but not Tracy.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Tracy! Are you okay...?!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Hm? How'd an employee get in here? Hello, miss. Did no one notify you that you don't need to clock in today?
Wynn notices her badge and name, and stops her before she can force her way past the police tape again.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: S-Sorry, I didn't mean to barge in... I mean, I meant to barge in... Tracy, um, the owner of this workstation is, uh, she's my friend. I heard she might be in trouble and I just... acted without thinking...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Your friend? We just finished a round of questioning with everyone in the office, and from what we heard, Tracy didn't get along with any of her coworkers.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: W-Well, that's to be expected. She hasn't been doing well lately, which has affected her work too... A-Actually, that's exactly why I got so scared. I just ran over the moment I found out...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Hasn't been doing well? Can you elaborate?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Tracy is very talented, even among contractors. She wouldn't have made it onto our project otherwise. But the pressure got to her, and for a while, she was on the verge of a breakdown, so I introduced her to the concept of stanning. And then...

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: She got hooked on Phanuel, and going to Phanuel's upcoming concert has been the only thing on her mind ever since.
Evie has clearly calmed down a little now, thanks to Wynn's patience and gentleness. She takes a moment to gather her thoughts, then points at the wall of Phanuel merch.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: She poured almost all of her savings, time, and energy into Phanuel, finally being chosen as a Special Cherub. That meant she earned the privilege to attend a fan-exclusive pilgrimage gathering.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: A few of the more dedicated fans mentioned this too. None of them seemed to have qualified, though. We haven't been able to identify the organizers or pin down the physical location either.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chances are... Tracy had the closest ties to the organizers out of them all, then.
Wynn grabs Evie by the arm, visibly excited.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Do you know who organized it? What about the location? We might still be able to stop it!
Evie lowers her head, anxiously wringing her fingers.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: What's wrong? You look a little hesitant.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I don't know the specifics either. Tracy and I... we haven't really talked in a long time.
Even so, she remembers every post Tracy has ever made. She scrolls straight to the right one like it's second nature, and holds it out to Wynn.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Found it. Here. A selfie she posted when she was taken to get a preview of the venue, plus a few countdown posts. Will these help?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Yes, of course! I'll have the intel department trace the location and deploy personnel right away! Evie, was it? Thank you. You've done a huge favor for us. For Tracy too!
Wynn is practically itching to leave with the lead right then and there, but Evie calls out and stops her.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Sorry... Can I come along too?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: ...Come again? This isn't exactly safe for an ordinary Eastside worker, you know...

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I follow idols closely, just like Tracy! I know my way around venues like this, and I've heard things about Phanuel from her! I'll probably be of some help... maybe...
Evie shifts nervously under the strangers' scrutiny. But the thought of Tracy being tangled up in that Hollow Syndrome is enough to make her steel herself.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I know I seem suspicious... But I promise I can help. None of my coworkers know, and I've never even told my parents either, but... I'm actually a Sinner.
The guards around them tense up, but Wynn immediately gestures for them to hold still.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Evie, are you aware of what could happen if you disclose your identity as a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I know. The Bureau sounds fine, honestly. It's okay. I never really liked my current job anyway... Tracy's the only coworker I can really talk to. There's not much holding me back.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Well, we could always use someone as genuine and brave as you as well. Not many would take on this much risk for a friend.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I'll notify Chief up through my terminal. Remember to get the shackles paperwork sorted out afterward, okay?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Do you mean...?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Come on, let's go save your friend!

Outside the Eastside Concert Venue
13:12
Jane peers through the café window. Outside, the entire street has been overtaken by pink bows and white wings.
Phanuel's face reaches as far as the eye can see—banners, flower walls, fan signs, and, of course, her fans' T-shirts.

steps.speaker: Fan
steps.content: Let's go through the chant one more time! Phanuel will definitely hear us from inside! Let all of Eastside witness the power of her Cherubs!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Yay!
Jane glances at the dense crowd outside, then back at the empty café. Looks like she's not getting any bonuses today.
With nothing else to do, she scrolls through her terminal, only to realize today's the deadline for paying her credit bill.
And then she sees her single-digit balance, along with the mission payout that still hasn't come through. She lets out a long sigh.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Come on, chin up. At least my debt could beat most people's. One, two, three, four, five, six... seven zeros...
She falls silent for a moment. As she's about to change back into her regular clothes and call Adjutant Nightingale for an update, her terminal lights up first.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Jane, you're close to Phanuel's concert venue according to the terminal. There's an emergency, and we need your help.
The call forcibly connects. Nightingale stares at the screen, taking in the sight of Jane in a maid outfit, and goes quiet for a moment.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Oh, um... this is for fieldwork.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...The Bureau has a strict non-interference policy regarding Sinners' personal hobbies, so long as public order is not affected.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: In that case, Miss Nightingale, I'd like to ask one thing. Why hasn't my pay for yesterday's mission come through yet?
Nightingale sighs and pulls up the surveillance feed of Joan's confinement cell on her terminal. The lock has been pried open, and Joan is nowhere to be seen.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I swear I didn't let her go.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I know. But the result wasn't maintained, so yesterday's mission can't be counted as completed.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She also broke the cell's security lock. Said to the camera, and I quote, "I'll make those people with no taste hear my music in person!"
Looking at the feed again, Joan has left an angry message scrawled in red paint:
Plagiarists don't deserve a stage! I'll be taking it now!

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: The emergency you mentioned... Is it about her escape?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. The crowd around the venue is massive. If she causes a scene at the concert, it could seriously endanger Eastside's public safety. All things considered, you're the best fit for this mission.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: You are aware that Joan is my closest friend and sworn sister, right, Miss Nightingale?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I'm not sure I follow. Didn't you just drag her to the Bureau for a reward?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Bump up the pay.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I'll have the Bureau's finance department recalculate the allowance.
After the call ends, Nightingale sends over a full set of emergency assistance documents.

Jane flips through it, leaning against the counter. The first few pages cover the security layout, venue entrances, and crowd control routes of Phanuel's concert. The last page is Joan's war-declaration graffiti.
Jane recalls the remark she casually made the night before.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Keep playing, and keep singing, until everyone has no choice but to listen. You're bound to be remembered that way.
Jane looks outside the café window again. A massive Phanuel poster hangs on the outer wall, and fans below are holding up their light boards, as if they're waiting for a miracle to descend.
No one knows who started it, but somewhere in the crowd, a Cherub begins humming the plagiarized melody. Others join in, one by one, until the tune echoes all the way till the venue entrance.
Jane puts away her terminal and unties the apron over her maid outfit.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: ...Joan.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I hope you don't end up like me...
With that, Jane climbs through the café window, scales up toward the rooftop, and scans the crowd below for any sign of Joan.
(Scene change)

The entire apartment building has completely fallen under FAC's control. They've claimed access to all security systems, and armed personnel have secured every entrance and exit. A squad fans out silently along the outer walls and fire exits, sealing the building from ground floor to rooftop.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Team A, secure the east balcony. Team B, come with me. Be ready to breach the front at any moment. The rest of you, take the west fire exit and lock down all remaining exits.
Following Eugene's signal, the team of MBCC guards and FAC operatives behind him files in. Yet, not a single footstep can be heard in the hallway of the apartment.
The moment Chief went dark, Eugene contacted the FAC squad assigned as support, and used the tracking terminal to pinpoint Phanuel's apartment.
Eugene crouches by the front door of the target unit, staring at the tablet screen. On it, he sees three human heat signatures: two in the living area, one near the master bedroom.
According to Wynn's latest report, the fan-organized rally is still growing, and the situation is spiraling out of control.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: We're running out of time. Remember, Chief's safety is our top priority. Avoid engaging ordinary civilians if possible.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Everyone, on my mark. Three—
Eugene holds the keycard provided by management up to the reader.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Two...
At the same time, Team A stands close to the edge of the balcony's window wall.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: One!
In one seamless motion, the keycard goes in, the handle turns, and the security door swings open. The team pours in like a torrent, seizing control of every corner in seconds.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Bureau, open up! Drop your weapons and put your hands up—
Eugene has barely barged in when he spots a familiar figure hard at work, a small black triangle bobbing cheerfully nearby, and two suited men flat on the floor.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief? What... are you doing?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oh, you're late. The little AI took these two guards down with neural shocks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nothing like good ol' machines for this kind of dirty work. You all best watch out, or you might just get replaced by AI.
You grab the two suited men by the ankles as you speak, and drag them toward the open area. Everyone else just stands there, guns in hand, watching you huff and puff through the whole thing alone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Hello? Some help over here?
(Scene change)
Only then do they all snap out of it. They quickly take over the cleanup and begin sweeping the rest of the apartment.
You look at the guards on the floor, then at your own people tearing through every cabinet and drawer. It's ironic, but you look more like criminals right now.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Found it. As we suspected, Chief, Mirrormoon Entertainment is just a shell company. Their real backer only entered the picture last year.

Eugene hands over the company's financial records. The statements show a fixed sum wired monthly from an import-export trading company over the past several years, with the memo field reading "advertising fee."

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I've already traced the trading company. It also has a fixed monthly expense to Harbour Culture, supposedly as "project service fees." Meanwhile, the only label under Harbour Culture is Startrack Productions, which is the primary organizer of Phanuel's concert.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It's curious as is that a concert of this scale would be handed to a company that has only organized two events since its founding, but... Care to guess who's connected to the first one, Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName} & Schorl
steps.content: Phantom Entertainment.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Additionally, Harbour Culture and the trading company are registered under the same address, building, and floor. Though I suspect that doesn't really come as a surprise at this point.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A shell company network, all registered by the same group, funneling money to Eliza and two secondary channels at the same time. This concert has been in the works far longer than we thought...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Schorl, mobilize every resource you can and shut down this concert immediately, on grounds of threatening public safety.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: About that, I'm afraid... we're too late.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't we still have two hours before it starts?

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: But this afternoon, a pilgrimage movement spread through the fanbase, and they've spontaneously gathered for a march near the venue ahead of schedule. The number of people there far exceeds the venue's capacity, in fact.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Based on the current situation, we cannot rule out the possibility that the march was organized and planned in advance—
Schorl switches on the television in the apartment remotely.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Phantom Entertainment has just released a public statement, which reads as follows:

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Phantom Entertainment acknowledges having previously provided financial support to Mirrormoon Entertainment, the agency to which artist Phanuel belongs. However, the statement emphasizes—

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Phantom Entertainment has never been involved in any creative, operational, or business decisions pertaining to Phanuel. All of Phanuel's statements, works, and stage performances are entirely unrelated to Phantom Entertainment.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: The statement also addresses recent claims online that Phanuel is being manipulated by financial backers behind the scenes, dismissing them as baseless conspiracy theories.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Phanuel comes from an ordinary background, with no powerful connections or backing. Everything she has achieved today was earned through her own hard work on stage and the unwavering support of her fans. Perhaps that is precisely why she has become the target of so much unwarranted speculation and criticism.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Phantom Entertainment trusts the Cherubs' judgment, and calls on everyone to stand together in support of Eastside's brightest star, to prevent those with ulterior motives from disrupting this hard-won concert.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: That concludes the statement. We will continue to keep you updated on further developments.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: They've already made their move and distanced themselves from the narrative, in turn removing themselves from this incident. They've likely anticipated that you'd see through Mirrormoon Entertainment, that it's only a matter of time until you trace it back to Phantom and Quinn...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But time's also all they need. Their winning condition is successfully holding this concert, where tens of thousands of Eastside citizens will gather as their hostages.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: If the Bureau's research data on the light sticks is accurate, and if the hypothesis about Hollow Syndrome spreading in sync holds... Given the current crowd density and emotional intensity around the venue, the probability of the situation remaining manageable is estimated at below thirty percent.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thirty percent... Let's not be too pessimistic just yet. After all, we still have one major wildcard.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't forget, I was already free before you found me.
[Flashback: In the Alley with Phanuel]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And before you do, there's one more favor I'd like to ask of you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That room Eliza keeps off-limits... is there any way you could get me close to it?
Phanuel sets down her ice cream and gives a small nod, casting a wary glance at the FAC guards keeping watch nearby.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't worry. I'll draw them away.
[Flashback: Bound in the Depot]

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Do you remember? The ice cream... the taste of summer, the taste of... freedom?
Phanuel unties the rope around your wrists.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I can't walk away from all of this. The stage, the lights, all the people waiting for Phanuel... I don't know what I am without Eliza.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But... maybe there really is another way? Maybe there's a part of me I've never even let myself hear?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza gave me a reason to exist. But I want to know your answer too. I want to know what I could be... under that open sky.
With the guards still gone, she slips a key into your hand.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza will be preoccupied with concert preparations all day. She shouldn't notice the key is missing. This is about all I can do.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: If the world beyond the stage really is as wonderful as you say... please, let Phanuel see it someday.
[Exit flashback]

The team gears up quickly and heads for the concert venue to rendezvous with Wynn's unit. Before leaving, Schorl conducts a final scan of the penthouse, a place that feels more like a showroom than a home.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: So, aside from confirming that Phanuel could potentially be turned, what information did you obtain here that was worth the risk?
You pull out a few fragments from your pocket, something you found around the living room, where Eliza had been influencing Phanuel mentally.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Incense of the Death.
